questions.solution: Articulation (न.) का अर्थ है स्पष्ट उच्चारण या अभिव्यक्ति की शक्ति।
'Cellar' is a room below ground level in a house, typically used for storing wine or coal. (तहखाना)
'Casino' is a public room or building where gambling games are played. (जुआघर)
'Curator' is a keeper or custodian of a museum or other collection. (संग्रहालय का अध्यक्ष)
'Bicentennial' is the two-hundredth anniversary of a significant event. (द्विशताब्दी)
'Choreographer' is a person who designs and directs the sequences of steps and movements for a dance. (नृत्य-निर्देशक)
A diatribe is a forceful and bitter verbal attack against someone or something. (शब्दों के माध्यम से किया गया तीखा और हिंसक हमला 'Diatribe' कहलाता है।)
'Cadence' is a modulation or inflection of the voice or a rhythmic flow of sounds. (ताल/स्वर का उतार-चढ़ाव)
'Anthology' is a published collection of poems or other pieces of writing.
'Bridle' is the headgear used to control a horse, consisting of buckled straps. (लगाम)
An anchor is the host of a broadcast show. Hindi: रेडियो या टीवी कार्यक्रम का संचालन करने वाला।
Dermatology is the branch of medicine concerned with the skin. (त्वचा के वैज्ञानिक अध्ययन को 'Dermatology' कहते हैं।)
An Adventurous person seeks out new and risky experiences. / Adventurous वह है जो जोखिम उठाने के लिए तैयार रहे।
'Altruist' is a person unselfishly concerned for or devoted to the welfare of others.
'Counterfeit' refers to something made in exact imitation of something valuable with the intention to deceive. (नकली/जालसाजी)
Aesthetic refers to the appreciation of beauty. / Aesthetic का संबंध सुंदरता और कला की समझ से है।
'Conscientious' describes a person wishing to do what is right, especially to do one's work or duty well. (ईमानदार/कर्तव्यनिष्ठ)
'Cloakroom' is a room in a public building where people can leave their coats or bags. (सामान रखने का कमरा)
'Centennial' relates to a hundredth anniversary. (सौवीं वर्षगाँठ)
To Act means to perform a function or a role. / Act का अर्थ कार्य करना या अभिनय करना होता है।
'Convoy' refers to a group of ships or vehicles traveling together, typically accompanied by armed protection. (वाहनों का रक्षक दल/काफिला)
Ablution is the act of washing or cleansing, often for religious purposes. (शुद्धि स्नान या धार्मिक स्नान)
Bachelor (न.) का अर्थ है कुंवारा व्यक्ति।
Adolescence is the transitional stage from childhood to adulthood. / Adolescence किशोरावस्था को कहते हैं।
'Contagious' refers to a disease spread by contact. (संक्रामक)
'Conscription' is the compulsory enlistment for state service, typically into the armed forces. (अनिवार्य सैन्य भर्ती)
'Console' means to comfort someone at a time of grief or disappointment. (सांत्वना देना)
'Contemporary' refers to living or occurring at the same time
Anniversary is a date that is remembered because a special event happened on it. Hindi: वह तारीख जिस पर पिछले किसी वर्ष में कोई घटना घटी थी (वर्षगांठ)।
'Brunette' refers to a woman or girl with dark brown hair. (सांवली/भूरे बालों वाली महिला)
To Activate means to trigger or start a process. / Activate का अर्थ किसी चीज़ को सक्रिय या चालू करना है।
'Coerce' means to persuade someone to do something by using force or threats. (मजबूर करना)
'Contented' means happy and at ease. (संतुष्ट)
'Botany' is the scientific study of the physiology, structure, genetics, and ecology of plants. (वनस्पति विज्ञान)
Adonis is used to describe a young man of great physical beauty. / Adonis का उपयोग बहुत सुंदर युवक के लिए किया जाता है।
To depict is to describe or show something in detail. (शब्दों या चित्रों के माध्यम से चित्रण करना 'Depict' कहलाता है।)
Absolution is a formal release from guilt or sin. (पाप-मुक्ति या क्षमादान)
An accountant manages financial records and books. (मुनीम या लेखाकार)
Auditor (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो खातों की जाँच करता है (लेखा परीक्षक)।
'Coercion' is the practice of persuading someone to do something by using force or threats. (जबर्दस्ती/दबाव)
Avaricious (वि.) का अर्थ है लालची या लोभी व्यक्ति।
Dipsomania is an uncontrollable craving for alcohol. (शराब पीने की तीव्र और बेकाबू लत को 'Dipsomania' कहते हैं।)
Disgraceful refers to behavior that is shameful or causes loss of respect. (शर्मनाक या अपमानजनक कार्य जो सम्मान कम करे, 'Disgraceful' कहलाता है।)
'Conformist' is a person who behaves in accordance with established standards. (अनुपालन करने वाला)
'Credible' means something that is able to be believed; convincing. (विश्वसनीय)
'Carnivorous' refers to animals that feed on other animals/flesh. (मांसाहारी)
'Chapel' is a small place for Christian worship, often attached to a larger institution. (छोटा गिरजाघर)
'Collusion' is a secret or illegal cooperation or conspiracy, especially in order to deceive others. (साठगांठ/मिलीजुली भगत)
'Bimonthly' can mean twice a month or once every two months. (द्विमासिक)
'Contaminated' means made impure by exposure to polluting substances. (दूषित)
'Catalogue' is a complete list of items, typically one in alphabetical or other systematic order. (सूचीपत्र)
'Circumlocution' is the use of many words where fewer would do, especially in a deliberate attempt to be vague. (शब्दबाहुल्य/घुमावदार बात)
An anecdote is a short account of a real incident. Hindi: किसी व्यक्ति या घटना के बारे में एक छोटा और रोचक किस्सा।
Atheist (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व में विश्वास नहीं करता (नास्तिक)।
Amicable refers to being friendly and peaceable. Hindi: मैत्रीपूर्ण और मिलनसार स्वभाव वाला व्यक्ति।
'Anthropologist' is an expert in or student of anthropology, the study of human societies and cultures and their development.
Bankrupt (न./वि.) का अर्थ है दिवालिया, जो अपना कर्ज चुकाने में असमर्थ हो।
'Carnage' is the killing of a large number of people. (नरसंहार/हत्याकांड)
'Convent' is a place where a community of nuns live and work together. (मठ/मन्दिर जहाँ नन रहती हैं)
'Conglomerate' is a large corporation formed by the merging of separate and diverse firms. (मिश्रित कंपनी/समूह)
'Apathy' is the noun form representing lack of interest, enthusiasm, or concern.
Autobiography (न.) का अर्थ है आत्मकथा, जो व्यक्ति स्वयं लिखता है।
'Coffer' is a strongbox or small chest for holding valuables. (तिजोरी)
'Budgeting' is the process of creating a plan to spend your money. (बजट बनाना)
'Cynic' is a person who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest rather than acting for honorable or unselfish reasons. (दोषदर्शी/मानवद्वेषी)
Avicide (न.) का अर्थ है पक्षियों की हत्या।
A disaster is a sudden accident or a natural catastrophe that causes great damage. (भीषण आपदा या विनाशकारी घटना को 'Disaster' कहते हैं।)
Demography involves studying population changes and statistics. (जनसंख्या और उसकी गतिशीलता के अध्ययन को 'Demography' कहते हैं।)
'Caw' is the harsh cry of a crow or similar bird. (काँव-काँव)
'Archive' is a collection of historical documents or records providing information about a place, institution, or group of people. (अभिलेखागार)
'Buzz' is a low, continuous humming or murmuring sound, made by or similar to that made by an insect. (भिनभिनाहट)
'Coincidence' is a remarkable concurrence of events or circumstances without apparent causal connection. (इत्तेफाक/संयोग)
'Caricature' is a picture or description of a person in which certain characteristics are exaggerated for comic effect. (व्यंग्य-चित्र)
'Appreciate' means to increase in monetary value over time. (मूल्य बढ़ना)
Abridgement is the result of shortening a piece of writing. (संक्षेपण या सारांश)
'Cauldron' is a large metal pot with a lid and handle, used for cooking over an open fire. (कड़ाहा)
'Bohemian' is a person who has informal and unconventional social habits. (रूढ़िमुक्त/स्वेच्छाचारी)
Avant-Garde (वि./न.) का अर्थ है कला के क्षेत्र में नए प्रयोग करने वाला अग्रणी समूह।
Deliberation is careful consideration before making a decision. (सोच-समझकर किया गया विचार या धीमी गति को 'Deliberation' कहते हैं।)
A deputy is a person who is given the power to do something instead of another person. (वह व्यक्ति जिसे दूसरे के स्थान पर कार्य करने के लिए नियुक्त किया गया हो, 'Deputy' कहलाता है।)
'Chauffeur' is a person employed to drive a private or luxury car. (शफर/ड्राइवर)
Acoustics is the branch of physics concerned with the properties of sound. (ध्वनि विज्ञान)
Anomaly is something that deviates from the standard or normal rule. Hindi: सामान्य नियम या स्थिति से भटकाव या विसंगति।
'Cerebral' relates to the brain or the use of the mind rather than feelings. (मस्तिष्क संबंधी/बौद्धिक)
'Charisma' is a personal quality of presence or charm that others find compelling. (प्रतिभा/आकर्षण)
'Centenarian' is a person who is a hundred or more years old. (सौ वर्ष का व्यक्ति)
'Arbitrator' is an independent person or body officially appointed to settle a dispute. (मध्यस्थ/पंच)
'Confectioner' is a person whose business is making or selling sweets and chocolates. (हलवाई)
'Ambience' is the character and atmosphere of a place (the mood or feeling of a specific environment).
To Aggrandize is to increase one's power or status. / Aggrandize का अर्थ शक्ति या पद बढ़ाना है।
'Brewery' is a place where beer is made commercially. (शराब की भठ्ठी)
Avoid (वि.) का अर्थ है दूर रहना या टालना।
'Bereft' means lacking something needed, wanted, or expected. (वंचित/विहीन)
A dilettante is a person who cultivates an area of interest, such as the arts, without real commitment or knowledge. (कला और साहित्य में केवल ऊपरी रुचि रखने वाला व्यक्ति 'Dilettante' कहलाता है।)
Ascetic (न.) का अर्थ है तपस्वी या आत्मसंयमी, जो शारीरिक सुखों का त्याग करता है।
Denature means to change the natural properties of a substance. (किसी वस्तु के प्राकृतिक गुणों को बदल देना 'Denature' कहलाता है।)
'Chafe' means to rub a part of the body to create warmth or because of irritation. (रगड़ना/खरोंचना)
Democracy is a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. (लोकतंत्र, जहाँ जनता अपने प्रतिनिधि चुनती है, 'Democracy' कहलाता है।)
Audit (न.) का अर्थ है खातों की आधिकारिक जाँच या लेखा परीक्षा।
'Alma Mater' refers to the school, college, or university that one formerly attended.
Deficiency is the lack of something required for the body. (विटामिन, खनिजों आदि की कमी को 'Deficiency' कहते हैं।)
An Agnostic is unsure if God exists. / Agnostic वह है जो ईश्वर के अस्तित्व पर संदेह करता है।
'Camouflage' is the use of materials or coloration for concealment. (छलावरण/छद्मावरण)
Dexterous means showing skill, especially with the hands. (हाथों के काम में निपुण या कुशल व्यक्ति को 'Dexterous' कहा जाता है।)
Delirium is a state of mental confusion during illness. (बीमारी के कारण मानसिक भ्रम या विक्षुब्ध अवस्था 'Delirium' कहलाती है।)
Amnesia is a medical condition where one loses memory. Hindi: याददाश्त का पूरी तरह या आंशिक रूप से चला जाना।
Anagram is formed by shuffling letters (e.g., 'Silent' to 'Listen'). Hindi: किसी शब्द के अक्षरों को आगे-पीछे करके बनाया गया नया शब्द।
'Chasm' is a deep opening or crack in the earth or a rock. (खाई/दरार)
'Apostate' is a person who has abandoned their religious or political beliefs. (धर्मत्यागी)
'Condone' means to accept or allow behavior that is considered morally wrong or offensive to continue. (नजरअंदाज करना/माफ करना)
Actionable refers to something that gives reason for a lawsuit. / Actionable वह है जिस पर कानूनी कार्रवाई की जा सके।
'Apologize' means to express regret for something one has done wrong.
'Biography' is an account of someone's life written by someone else. (जीवनी)
To diagnose is to identify the nature of an illness by looking at symptoms. (निरीक्षण के द्वारा रोग की पहचान करना 'Diagnose' कहलाता है।)
Ballad (न.) का अर्थ है गाथा-गीत या लोक-गीत जो कहानी सुनाता है।
'Chronic' refers to an illness or condition that persists for a long time. (दीर्घकालिक/पुरानी बीमारी)
'Clientele' refers to the customers of a shop, bar, or place of entertainment. (ग्राहकगण)
'Biology' is the natural science that studies life and living organisms. (जीव विज्ञान)
'Beneficiary' is the person who receives help or advantage from something like a will or insurance. (लाभार्थी)
'Change' is the act or instance of making or becoming different. (परिवर्तन)
'Catastrophic' is the adjective form describing something involving or causing sudden great damage. (विनाशकारी)
A directory is a book or list of names, addresses, or telephone numbers. (नामों और पतों की सूची वाली पुस्तक को 'Directory' कहते हैं।)
Depraved describes someone with no moral principles. (नैतिक रूप से भ्रष्ट या चरित्रहीन व्यक्ति को 'Depraved' कहते हैं।)
'Ambassador' is an accredited diplomat sent by a country as its official representative to a foreign country.
'Boomerang' is a curved flat piece of wood that can be thrown so that it returns to the thrower. (बुमेरांग/एक हथियार जो फेंकने वाले के पास लौट आता है)
Atonement (न.) का अर्थ है प्रायश्चित या क्षतिपूर्ति करना।
'Chase' means to pursue someone or something in order to catch them. (पीछा करना)
'Bungalow' is a low house having only one story or, in some cases, upper rooms set in the roof. (बंगला)
Assent (वि.) का अर्थ है किसी सुझाव या प्रस्ताव पर सहमति देना।
Accolade is an award or privilege granted as a special honour. (सम्मान या पुरस्कार)
'Cache' is a collection of items of the same type stored in a hidden or inaccessible place. (गुप्त भंडार)
'Complacent' means showing smug or uncritical satisfaction with oneself or one's achievements. (आत्मसंतुष्ट)
'Corroborate' means to confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding with evidence. (साक्ष्य द्वारा पुष्टि करना)
'Alluvium' is a deposit of clay, silt, and sand left by flowing floodwater in a river valley or delta.
Acerbic refers to a sharp or biting way of speaking or acting. (कड़वा, तीखा या सख्त)
'Antipathy' refers to a deep-seated feeling of dislike or aversion.
'Ambidextrous' refers to a person who is able to use the right and left hands with equal ease.
'Anorexia' is an eating disorder characterized by an abnormally low body weight and an intense fear of gaining weight.
'Cannibal' is a person who eats the flesh of other human beings. (नरभक्षी)
'Appertain' means to be appropriate or applicable to something. (संबद्ध होना/लागू होना)
Benefactor (न.) वह व्यक्ति है जो दूसरों की आर्थिक या अन्य सहायता करता है (धर्मोपकारी)।
Articulate का अर्थ होता है स्पष्ट रूप से बोलने में कुशल। Having the ability to speak fluently and coherently.
'Archaeologist' is a person who studies human history through the excavation of sites. (पुरातात्विक)
'Confiscate' means to take or seize someone's property with authority. (जब्त करना)
'Ceasefire' is a temporary suspension of fighting; a truce. (युद्धविराम)
'Culture' includes the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a particular people or society. (संस्कृति)
Barracks (न.) का अर्थ है सैनिकों के रहने का स्थान (छावनी)।
'Bower' is a pleasant shady place under trees or climbing plants in a garden or wood. (कुंज/लता-मंडप)
'Cluck' is the short, low sound made by a hen. (मुर्गी की आवाज़)
'Corpus' is a collection of written or spoken texts, especially the entire works of a particular author or a body of writing on a particular subject. (किसी लेखक या विषय पर लिखित लेखों का संग्रह)
A dermatologist is a specialist doctor for skin issues. (त्वचा रोगों के विशेषज्ञ चिकित्सक को 'Dermatologist' कहा जाता है।)
'Cocktail' is an alcoholic drink consisting of a spirit or several spirits mixed with other ingredients. (मिश्रित पेय)
Autonomy (न.) का अर्थ है स्वशासन या स्वायत्तता।
Disenfranchisement means the state of being deprived of a right or privilege, especially the right to vote. (मताधिकार या नागरिक अधिकारों से वंचित होना 'Disenfranchisement' कहलाता है।)
'Bizarre' describes something that is very strange or unusual. (अजीब/विचित्र)
'Bovine' relates to or affects cattle (cows/oxen). (गो-जातीय)
'Congregation' is a group of people assembled for religious worship. (धर्मसभा/भक्त-मंडली)
Diffuse means spread out over a large area; not concentrated. (व्यापक रूप से फैलना या फैलाना 'Diffuse' कहलाता है।)
Abbreviation is a shortened form of a word or phrase. (शब्दों का संक्षिप्त रूप)
'Alumnus' refers to a graduate or former student of a particular school, college, or university.
A daredevil is someone who takes unnecessary risks. (साहसी या दुस्साहसी व्यक्ति जो खतरनाक काम करना पसंद करता है।)
'Ambiguous' means open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
Acquit means to formally declare someone is not guilty. / Acquit का अर्थ है किसी को निर्दोष घोषित करना।
'Apostasy' is the abandonment or renunciation of a religious or political belief. (धर्मत्याग/स्वधर्मत्याग)
Assailant (न.) का अर्थ है हमलावर या आक्रमणकारी।
Ancient means something from a very long time ago. Hindi: बहुत पुराने समय या प्राचीन काल का।
'Alliteration' is the occurrence of the same letter or sound at the beginning of adjacent or closely connected words.
'Cortege' is a solemn procession, especially for a funeral. (अंतिम संस्कार के लिए निकाला गया जुलूस/शव-यात्रा)
'Caucus' is a meeting of the members of a particular political party to select candidates or decide policy. (दल की सभा/बैठक)
'Arable' land is land capable of being ploughed and used to grow crops. (कृषि योग्य)
'Conceivable' means capable of being imagined or grasped mentally. (कल्पनीय/समझ में आने योग्य)
'Carol' is a religious folk song or popular hymn, particularly one associated with Christmas. (ईसाई भजन/क्रिसमस के गीत)
'Biopsy' is an examination of tissue removed from a living body to discover the presence or cause of a disease. (जीवोति-जांच)
'Cockpit' is the compartment for the pilot and sometimes also the crew in an aircraft. (कॉकपिट)
Axiom (न.) का अर्थ है स्वयं सिद्ध सत्य या सूक्ति।
Aggressive describes someone ready to fight. / Aggressive का अर्थ आक्रामक या झगड़ालू होता है।
'Bibliophile' is a person who collects or has a great love of books. (पुस्तकाप्रेमी)
'Apathetic' is an adjective describing someone showing or feeling no interest, enthusiasm, or concern.

'Cemetery' is a large burial ground, especially one not next to a church. (कब्रिस्तान)
Assertive (वि.) का अर्थ है अपनी बात को दृढ़ता और आत्मविश्वास से कहना।
Alchemy was the medieval forerunner of chemistry. / Alchemy प्राचीन या मध्यकालीन रसायन विद्या है।
A detective is someone whose job is to discover information about crimes. (अपराधों की जांच करने और उन्हें सुलझाने वाले व्यक्ति को 'Detective' कहते हैं।)
Deranged refers to someone who is mentally unbalanced or insane. (मानसिक बीमारी के कारण विक्षिप्त या पागल व्यक्ति को 'Deranged' कहते हैं।)
An Album is a book for collections. / Album वह किताब है जिसमें चित्र या टिकट रखे जाते हैं।
Anatomy studies the physical structure of living organisms. Hindi: शरीर रचना विज्ञान।
'Compunction' is a feeling of guilt or moral scruple that follows the doing of something bad. (पछतावा/आत्मग्लानि)
'Aphasia' is a condition that robs you of the ability to communicate, often caused by a stroke or head injury.
Adorable means inspiring great affection or delight. / Adorable का अर्थ बहुत प्यारा और आकर्षक होता है।
'Anthropology' is the scientific study of humanity, concerned with human behavior, human biology, cultures, societies, and linguistics.
Abdicate means to formally give up a high office or throne. (स्वेच्छा से पद या सिंहासन त्यागना)
'Croak' is the characteristic deep hoarse sound made by a frog or a crow. (मेंढक की आवाज़/टर्राना)
'Chagrin' is a feeling of being annoyed or disappointed because of a failure or humiliation. (चिढ़/क्षोभ)
'Conscience' is a person's moral sense of right and wrong. (विवेक/अन्तःकरण)
'Concubinage' is the state of a man and a woman living together without being married. (बिना विवाह साथ रहना)
Bandying (वि.) का अर्थ है किसी शब्द या विचार का बार-बार या लापरवाही से प्रयोग करना।
'Alpinism' is the sport or activity of climbing high mountains.
'Cartographer' is a person who creates or produces maps. (मानचित्रकार)
Aberration means a departure from what is normal or expected. (असामान्यता या पथ-विचलन)
'Contiguous' means sharing a common border; touching. (सटा हुआ/संलग्न)
'Carcass' is the dead body of an animal, especially one slaughtered and used for food. (पशु का शव)
Algophobia is the extreme or irrational fear of experiencing pain. / Algophobia शारीरिक दर्द महसूस होने का एक असामान्य या अत्यधिक डर है।
To delegate is to entrust a task or responsibility to another. (अपना अधिकार किसी और को सौंपना 'Delegate' कहलाता है।)
An Advocate is a person who supports a cause. / Advocate वह व्यक्ति है जो किसी पक्ष का समर्थन करता है।
'Canophilia' is the love or fondness for dogs. (कुत्तों से प्रेम)
'Arsonphobia' (also known as Pyrophobia) is the irrational fear of fire. (आग से डर)
Aboriginal means relating to the original inhabitants of a place. (आदिम या मूल निवासी से संबंधित)
'Apartment' is a suite of rooms forming one residence, typically in a building containing others.
'Callous' means showing or having an insensitive and cruel disregard for others. (कठोर/निर्दयी)
'Configuration' is an arrangement of parts or elements in a particular form, figure, or combination. (विन्यास/आकृति)
To Adhere means to follow or stick to a belief or rule. / Adhere का अर्थ किसी नियम या विश्वास का पालन करना है।
'Clamorous' means making a loud and confused noise. (शोर मचाने वाला)
'Antidote' is a medicine taken or given to counteract a particular poison.
'Allegory' uses symbols to convey a deeper moral or political meaning. 'Alliteration' is the repetition of sounds, 'Alpinism' is mountain climbing, and 'Alluvium' is soil deposited by water.
'Bibliomania' is an excessive fondness for acquiring and possessing books. (किताबों का पागलपन)
'Applicant' is a person who makes a formal application for something, especially a job. (आवेदक)
'Casserole' is a large, deep dish used both in the oven and as a serving vessel. (एक गहरा बर्तन)
'Cascade' is a small waterfall, typically one of several that fall in stages down a rocky slope. (झरना/जलप्रपात)
Annihilate means to wipe out or destroy utterly. Hindi: पूरी तरह से नष्ट कर देना या मिटा देना।
'Bibliography' is a list of books and articles consulted by an author. (ग्रंथसूची)
'Anticipate' means to expect or predict a future event and prepare for it.
Bark (न.) का अर्थ है पेड़ की छाल।
To deride means to express contempt for someone; to ridicule. (किसी का क्रूरतापूर्वक मज़ाक उड़ाना या उपहास करना 'Deride' कहलाता है।)
'Brigand' is a member of a gang that ambushes and robs people in forests or mountains. (डाकू/लुटेरा)
'Commission' is a sum of money paid to an agent in a commercial transaction. (आढ़त/कमीशन)
Bask (वि.) का अर्थ है आनंद लेना या धूप सेंकना।
Analogy is a comparison between two things for explanation. Hindi: दो चीजों के बीच समानता के आधार पर तुलना।
'Consummate' means showing high degree of skill and flair; complete or perfect. (उत्कृष्ट/पूर्ण)
'Colony' refers to a group of certain animals or insects (like ants) living together. (बस्ती/चींटियों का समूह)
Banter (न.) का अर्थ है मित्रों के बीच होने वाला मज़ाक या हंसी-ठिठोली।
'Contagion' is the communication of disease from one person to another by close contact. (छूत/संक्रमण)
'Cosmopolitan' is a person who is free from local or national prejudices and considers the whole world as their home. (सर्वदेशीय/जो पूरे विश्व को अपना घर माने)
Anonymous means having an unknown or unacknowledged name/author. Hindi: जिसका नाम ज्ञात न हो (गुमनाम)।
'Bombard' means to attack continuously with questions, criticisms, or information. (बौछार करना)
'Capitalist' is a wealthy person who uses money to invest in trade and industry for profit. (पूंजीपति)
An Acrobat is a performer of gymnastic feats. / Acrobat वह कलाकार है जो कठिन शारीरिक करतब दिखाता है।
'Condominium' is a building or complex of buildings containing a number of individually owned apartments or houses. (एक अपार्टमेंट जिसमें निजी और साझा क्षेत्र दोनों हों)
Avalanche (न.) का अर्थ है हिमस्खलन।
'Currency' is a system of money in general use in a particular country. (मुद्रा)
Dereliction is the shameful failure to fulfill one's obligations or duties. (अपने कर्तव्य या जिम्मेदारी का पालन न करना 'Dereliction' कहलाता है।)
An anarchist wants to bring a state of lawlessness. Hindi: वह जो शासन या सरकार को न माने (अराजकतावादी)।
'Bonus' is an extra amount of money that is added to a payment or wages as a reward. (पारितोषिक/अधिलाभांश)
'Citadel' is a fortress, typically one on high ground above a city. (किला/गढ़)
'Almanac' is an annual publication listing a set of events forthcoming in the next year (weather, sunrises, etc.).
Algaecide is a chemical used to kill and prevent the growth of algae. / Algaecide एक ऐसा रसायन है जिसका उपयोग शैवाल (algae) को मारने और उनकी वृद्धि को रोकने के लिए किया जाता है।
'Amateur' is a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid rather than a professional basis.
Barometer (न.) वायुदाबमापी यंत्र है।
'Brood' is a family of young animals, especially birds, produced at one hatching or birth. (पक्षियों का झोंट/एक ही बार के बच्चे)
'Chiromancy' is the art or practice of telling fortunes from the lines on the palm of the hand. (हस्तरेखा विद्या)
'Bookworm' is a person who enjoys reading very much and spends a lot of time doing it. (किताबी कीड़ा)
A derelict is a person who has no home or job and is often in poor health. (वह व्यक्ति जिसके पास न घर हो, न नौकरी और न ही संपत्ति, 'Derelict' कहलाता है।)
'Biennial' describes something that happens once every two years. (द्विवार्षिक)
'Curfew' is a regulation requiring people to remain indoors between specified hours, typically at night. (कर्फ्यू/निषेधाज्ञा)
'Bungle' means to do something badly or without skill. (काम बिगाड़ देना/भूल करना)
'Cryptography' is the art of writing or solving codes. (कूटलेखन/गुप्त लेखन का अध्ययन)
'Curse' is a solemn utterance intended to invoke a supernatural power to inflict harm or punishment on someone or something. (शाप देना)
A delinquent is a young offender who commits minor crimes. (अपराध करने वाला किशोर 'Delinquent' कहलाता है।)
'Bonsai' is the art of growing ornamental, artificially dwarfed trees or shrubs in pots. (बौने पौधे उगाने की कला)
An ambivert is a person whose personality has a balance of extrovert and introvert features. Hindi: वह व्यक्ति जिसमें अंतर्मुखी और बहिर्मुखी दोनों गुण हों।
'Contraband' refers to goods that have been imported or exported illegally. (वर्जित माल/तस्करी का माल)
'Calligrapher' is a person who practices the art of beautiful handwriting. (सुलेखक)
'Criterion' is a principle or standard by which something may be judged or decided. (मापदंड/कसौटी)
Battery (न.) का अर्थ है तोपों या मिसाइल लॉन्चरों का समूह।
'Aquatic' refers to organisms living or growing in water. (जलीय)
'Alien' refers to someone from a foreign country or a different world. 'Alumnus' is a former student, 'Altruist' is a charitable person, and 'Ambassador' is a diplomatic representative.
To defend means to guard against attack or harm. (नुकसान या खतरे से बचाना 'Defend' कहलाता है।)
'Compatriots' are fellow citizens or nationals of a country. (देशभाई/हमवतन)
'Chore' is a routine task, especially a household one that is often perceived as tedious. (घर का काम)
'Culpable' means deserving blame or being responsible for a fault or wrong. (दोषी/अपराधी)
Ameliorate means to improve a bad situation. Hindi: किसी खराब स्थिति को बेहतर बनाना (सुधारना)।
Abattoir is a place where animals are killed for meat. (कसाईखाना)
'Compere' is a person who introduces the performers or contestants in a variety show. (कार्यक्रम का संचालक)
Disgruntled means angry or dissatisfied. (किसी बात से निराश और चिड़चिड़ा महसूस करने वाला व्यक्ति 'Disgruntled' कहलाता है।)
'Cardiology' is the branch of medicine that deals with diseases and abnormalities of the heart. (हृदय विज्ञान)
'Bevy' is used to describe a large group of people or things of a particular kind. (झुंड/टोली)
Autocrat (न.) का अर्थ है तानाशाह या एकछत्र शासक जिसके पास पूर्ण शक्ति होती है।
Amnesty is a general pardon granted by a government. Hindi: राजनैतिक अपराधियों को दी जाने वाली औपचारिक माफी (राजक्षमा)।
'Archaeology' is the scientific study of material remains (such as tools, pottery, jewelry, stone walls, and monuments) of past human life and activities. (पुरातत्व विज्ञान)
'Creed' is a set of beliefs or aims which guide someone's actions. (पंथ/धर्ममत)
To disguise is to give a new appearance to a person or thing to hide its true nature. (अपनी पहचान छिपाने के लिए भेष बदलना 'Disguise' कहलाता है।)
'Cryptograph' is a device or system for writing or solving codes and ciphers. (गुप्तलेख यंत्र)
Deliquesce means to dissolve or become liquid. (सड़ने के दौरान तरल बन जाने की प्रक्रिया 'Deliquesce' कहलाती है।)
'Beverage' is a drink of any type (other than water). (पेय पदार्थ)
'Conspiracy' is a secret plan by a group to do something unlawful or harmful. (साजिश/षड्यंत्र)
'Colleague' is a person with whom one works in a profession or business. (सहकर्मी)
Defamation is the act of damaging someone's good name. (किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को नुकसान पहुँचाना 'Defamation' या मानहानि कहलाता है।)
'Claustrophobia' is the extreme or irrational fear of confined places. (छोटे स्थानों का डर)
'Altimeter' is an instrument used in aircraft to measure its altitude above a fixed level.
'Clamour' is a loud and confused noise, especially that of people shouting vehemently. (कोलाहल/जोरदार मांग)
Astrologer (न.) वह है जो सितारों को देखकर भविष्य बताता है (ज्योतिषी)।
Anarchy is a state of disorder due to absence of authority. Hindi: देश में सरकार या कानून व्यवस्था का न होना (अराजकता)।
Abate refers to something becoming less intense or severe. (तीव्रता में कमी आना या शांत होना)
'Bourgeois' refers to the middle class, typically with reference to its perceived materialistic values. (मध्यमवर्गीय)
Cynophobia refers to the irrational fear of dogs. (कुत्तों के प्रति अत्यधिक भय को Cynophobia कहते हैं।)
Avidity (न.) का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ के प्रति तीव्र उत्साह या लालसा।
'Blasphemy' is the action or offence of speaking sacrilegiously about God or sacred things. (ईश-निंदा)
Cytology is the scientific study of cells. (कोशिकाओं के अध्ययन को 'Cytology' कहा जाता है।)
'Conflagrant' means burning or blazing. (ज्वलनशील)
'Clamber' means to climb or move in an awkward and laborious way. (हाथ-पैर के बल चढ़ना)
'Crusade' is a vigorous campaign for political, social, or religious change. (धर्मयुद्ध/आंदोलन)
'Constrained' means appearing forced or overly controlled. (विवश/बाधित)
'Conceited' means excessively proud of oneself; vain. (अभिमानी/घमंडी)
'Credulous' is a person who is too ready to believe things and is therefore easily deceived. (भोला-भाला/जो आसानी से विश्वास कर ले)
'Burglar' is a person who commits theft by entering a building illegally. (सेंधमार/चोर)
'Cacophony' is a harsh, discordant mixture of sounds. (कोलाहल/कटु स्वर)
A dictator is a ruler with total power over a country, typically one who has obtained control by force. (तानाशाह या वह शासक जिसके पास असीमित शक्तियां हों, 'Dictator' कहलाता है।)
'Catalyst' is a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction. (उत्प्रेरक)
'Crematorium' is a place where a dead person's body is cremated (burned). (शमशान घाट)
'Concentric' refers to circles or spheres which have the same centre. (सकेन्द्रित)
'Archipelago' is a group or chain of islands clustered together in a sea or ocean. (द्वीपसमूह)
'Amaxophobia' is the persistent and intense fear of being a passenger in a car or other moving vehicle.
Bellicose (वि.) का अर्थ है लड़ाकू या युद्धप्रिय।
A den is the wild habitat or home of a lion. (शेर के रहने के स्थान को 'Den' या गुफा कहा जाता है।)
'Contingency' is a future event or circumstance which is possible but cannot be predicted with certainty. (आकस्मिकता)
'Conjecture' is an opinion or conclusion formed on the basis of incomplete information. (अनुमान/अंदाजा)
'Chaff' refers to the outer husks of grain that are separated during the threshing process. (भूसा/अनाज का छिलका)
Amble means to walk in a slow, relaxed way. Hindi: धीरे-धीरे या बिना किसी खास उद्देश्य के टहलना।
Decoding is the act of converting a coded message into plain text. (गुप्त संदेशों को पढ़ने योग्य भाषा में बदलने को 'Decoding' कहते हैं।)
Abbot is the head of an abbey or monastery. (मठ का प्रधान)
Authentic (वि.) का अर्थ है विश्वसनीय, असली या प्रामाणिक।
Diagnosis is the identification of an illness or other problem. (बीमारी की पहचान करने की प्रक्रिया को 'Diagnosis' कहते हैं।)
'Ardor' means great enthusiasm, passion, or love. (उत्साह/जोश)
'Bleat' is the characteristic wavering cry made by a sheep, goat, or calf. (मिमियाना)
'Cobweb' is a spider's web, especially when old and covered with dust. (मकड़ी का जाला)
Bellow (वि.) का अर्थ है गरजना या जोर से चिल्लाना (जैसे मगरमच्छ की आवाज़)।
'Altitude' is the vertical distance of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.
'Coast' is the part of the land adjoining or near the ocean or sea. (तट/किनारा)
'Antithesis' refers to a person or thing that is the direct opposite of someone or something else.
Deterrence is meant to stop someone from doing something by showing them the bad results. (दुष्परिणामों का डर दिखाकर किसी कार्य को रोकने की क्रिया 'Deterrence' कहलाती है।)
'Confess' means to admit that one has committed a crime or done something wrong. (कबूल करना)
To defame is the verbal or written action of hurting a reputation. (किसी की प्रतिष्ठा को धूमिल करने की क्रिया 'Defame' कहलाती है।)
Animosity is a strong feeling of anger or lack of friendship. Hindi: गहरी दुश्मनी या शत्रुता की भावना।
An Agenda is a schedule of matters to be dealt with. / Agenda वह सूची है जिस पर बैठक में चर्चा होनी है।
'Churlish' means rude in a mean-spirited and surly way. (असभ्य/उजड्ड)
'Brittle' means hard but liable to break or shatter easily. (भंगुर/नाजुक)
'Antonym' is a word opposite in meaning to another (e.g. bad and good).
Auditorium (न.) का अर्थ है सभागार या प्रेक्षागृह जहाँ दर्शक बैठते हैं।
A dirge is a mournful song, a piece of music, or a sound. (शोकगीत जो किसी की मृत्यु पर गाया जाए, 'Dirge' कहलाता है।)
